Theme

Latin word

exanimātus

exanimātus, exanimāta, exanimātum

declension

out of breath, exhausted; also half dead with fright

In this lexicon

  • out of breath

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Asin. 265: exanimātus currit hūc Leōnida; Caes. BG 2.23.1: cursū ac lassitūdine exanimātī (Lewis & Short)

  • exanimātus metū: scared to death

    classical

Examples

  • sed quid illuc, quod exanimātus currit hūc Leōnida?

    but what’s this? Leonida running here out of breath?Plaut. Asin. 265

    In the entry for out of breath

  • nimis male timuī. Prius quam intrō rediī, exanimātus fuī.

    I was dreadfully frightened. Before I got back inside, I was half dead.Plaut. Aul. 208

    In the entry for out of breath
